description: Creative director: turn a brand + product/brief into a finished ad CONCEPT — copy variants (headline/primary/cta) plus an image_concept.prompt OR a video_storyboard, with the resolved recipe + the model ids to render with. Renders nothing; chain its output into generate_image / generate_video. THE USER’S EXPLICIT LENGTH IS SOVEREIGN: when they name a duration ("a 30 second ad", "make it 45s"), pass it as durationSeconds — the board is then AUTHORED to that length (its scenes sum to it) and render_ad renders it as one clip or stitched acts accordingly. Leaving it out lets the planner pick its own default, which is how an explicit ask silently becomes a 15s spot. The user’s OWN screenshots or pictures cut into the video full-screen go in `inserts`: the board keeps those seconds free of any screen, and render_ad lays the real pictures in. Spends credits.

brand.description: brand name, or a brand profile object {name,domain,category,palette,products,…}. OMIT to use the workspace’s SAVED brand + memory automatically (see get_brand); use draft_brand to onboard a new one

draft.description: ONLY after a video refusal that offered a light draft: the {model, durationSeconds} it named. The plan is then authored to that length and priced on that model. Never invent one — a video the account cannot cover is refused BEFORE planning with the three options (image / add credits / this draft when one fits), and the user chooses.

durationSeconds.description: VIDEO ONLY — the total spot length the user explicitly asked for, in seconds, copied verbatim (30 for "a 30 second ad"). The planner authors the storyboard TO it: the scenes’ seconds sum to it and the script is word-budgeted for it. Supported range 4–180; anything outside is CLAMPED to it (the reply says so). A length that fits ONE clip of the render model renders as a single continuous pass; anything longer is STITCHED from acts filled to that model’s clip maximum with the remainder last (on a 15s-clip model, 40 -> 15+15+10 and 17 -> 13+4) — never time-compressed. The maximum is the model’s own: 15s on most, 30s on the longest-clip model, so a 30s ad can be one unbroken take rather than two acts. Omit when the user named no length; do NOT pass a guess: when it is omitted the planner picks a length suited to the format, and a length the user names always wins.

hook.description: force the VISUAL scroll-stop mechanic the opening beat is built on — a hook id from list_hooks (e.g. "direct_callout", "mid_problem", "macro_asmr"). Omit to let the planner pick. A hook that cannot be delivered in this brief is DROPPED with the reason rather than rendered wrongly — an on-screen-text hook on an authentic/UGC ad is the one that bites, because that register carries zero on-screen text.

inserts.description: VIDEO ONLY: the user's own SCREENS (an app, a page, a dashboard, a document, a review, a chart) shown at these seconds as a rounded card over the upper middle of the footage, which keeps playing around it (look 'full' covers the frame, only when the user asked), the voice running underneath. Fewer and shorter: about one per 4 s of film, 1.2-2 s each, on the line that talks about it; never in the first second or the last 1.5 s. The plan frames those shots for the card, keeps them free of screens, and returns the pictures as creative.inserts for render_ad to lay in (about 2 credits). A photo of a person, product or place (kind 'photo') is not laid in: pass a product photo as the brand's product photo and a person as a saved creator. One that does not fit is left out and the reply says so.

end.description: second it ends: at most 2 s after start (2.5 s full-screen), never in the last 1.5 s of the film

image.description: an https or upload_file URL, a Library id (L0, L1…) or a local path on the CLI

kind.description: screen (default): an app, a page, a dashboard, a document, a review, a chart. photo: a person, a product or a place, which is NOT laid over the video (a product photo goes in as the brand's product photo, a person to star as a saved creator)

look.description: card (default): a rounded card over the upper middle of the footage, which keeps playing. full: covers the whole frame, ONLY when the user asked for full-screen

start.description: second it appears (never before 1 s: the film opens on moving footage)

language.description: output language for the ad copy (e.g. Spanish) — default English

product.description: what to advertise + any angle/offer the user specified

recipe.description: a recipe id from hermoso_capabilities to force an archetype

reference.description: a reference to clone: an ad-library link (Facebook Ad Library, LinkedIn Ad Library, Google Ads Transparency — its real copy/advertiser are fetched) OR a VIDEO link — a TikTok, Instagram Reel, Facebook video, X post, YouTube Short/video or a direct video file — which is WATCHED first (frames + voiceover/on-screen-text transcript) so the concept keeps its hook, structure and pacing. To remake one video for this brand at its own length, clone_video is the direct tool

setting.description: force the WHERE — a setting id from list_hooks (e.g. "kitchen", "gym", or a surreal one like "volcano_rim" / "airplane_wing", which are played 100% straight and never acknowledged). Omit for a neutral setting.

talent.description: who is on camera; omit to follow the format. Say 'someone new' in product to skip reusing a saved creator.

name: plan_ad
title: Plan an ad concept
